new_theme: Parameter-tune L2 (test): retune a baseband PAM test transmitter from 2-PAM at 1 kBd to Gray-coded 4-PAM at 2.4 kBd by changing parameter values only. The start graph runs at 48 kHz: Vector Source (8 listed bytes, repeating) -> Packed To Unpacked (1 bit, MSB first) -> Chunks To Symbols (float, [-1, 1], dimension 1) -> Repeat 48 -> Throttle -> File Sink pam.dat (float), plus an Import block 'from gnuradio import gr'. GRC evaluates gr.GR_MSB_FIRST only when some block imports gr, and none of these blocks does. Reference edit: bits_per_chunk 2, symbol_table [-3, -1, 3, 1], Repeat 20. Signature v2 data_source|linear_mod|resample -> test; build.py asserts that the start graph and all variants share it. cluster_id chain:data_source|linear_mod|resample.

accepted.change: The defect (the unchecked test tones of the decimator bench) is gone with the re-theme. Its lesson is applied to the new content: every 'keep' requirement is checked, and each has a mutant that only its check kills. samp_rate 57600 leaves the samples unchanged and is killed by the p2p graph check block_present variable 48000. Bypassing the Throttle leaves the samples unchanged and is killed by same_blocks_as_start / same_connections_as_start. No known survivors exist: 12/12 mutants are valid and killed.

Still applies (the item is again a composed L2). Recorded in review.notes for the team decision listed in fix_plan team_decisions. The L2 label follows R7: 6 functional blocks, rate changes (unpacking, Repeat) and symbol mapping.

Moot for the new content (there is no test signal). The principle is applied: the instruction's constraints ('change parameter values only', 'keep the 48 kHz sample rate') are enforced by p2p graph checks (same_blocks_as_start with variables value_only, same_connections_as_start isomorphic, block_present variable 48000). The output requirement is one exact f2p check: equal_prefix of the first 1920 samples (three data periods), max_offset 0. It pins bits per symbol, bit order, the Gray table, levels, symbol rate, data and start sample together.
Applies; fixed. The instruction ends with the set run sentence (R5), and spec_properties has 'run' (V5 liveness, 2560 items).

rejected.reason: Moot. The decimator structure is gone, and signature v2 (an order-independent set of functional classes, with plumbing dropped and equivalent filter blocks merged) settled the set-level point. The new start, reference and all three variants have the single signature data_source|linear_mod|resample (test); build.py asserts this. A parameter-tune item cannot be restructured without failing its value-only checks.

other_changes: Variants (3), each value-only and producing the reference's samples exactly. v1: the table as a float tuple and Repeat int(samp_rate/2400). v2: LSB-first unpacking of bit-reversed bytes, which gives the same bit stream and the same 2-bit chunks (measured in GNU Radio: LSB-first still puts the first extracted bit in the chunk's MSB). v3: 4-bit chunks with Chunks To Symbols dimension 2 and a 32-entry table. The instruction defines the data as a bit stream ('the eight bytes above in that order, each byte most significant bit first'), so v2 obeys it literally.

Mutants (12): natural-binary table, reversed table order, inverted polarity, levels scaled by 1/2, LSB first, 1 bit per chunk, Repeat 24 (2 kBd), Repeat 48 (start rate), one data bit changed, samp_rate 57600, Throttle bypassed, output file renamed.
Oracle limit in review.notes: no output sample depends on samp_rate, so the sample rate is checked as a graph fact; the Throttle's own rate parameter is not checked.
